title: Great  Stackable Organizer!
text: Great  Stackable Organizer!. I wanted something to organize our large linen closet as the husband tended to just stuff things in, rather than putting them where they belonged.  Now with all the linens in these zippered bags, the closet stays organized easily.  Compared to others I bought, I really like that they have a metal frame which allows them to stack and that keeps ever organizer in a square shape.  Whereas the ones without frames look messy as the tops and sides cave in, these look wonderfully uniform.  The handles are sturdy, too.  The only negative is that they had a slight chemical smell when they first arrived, but that lessened after they were allowed to air out for several days.
